headline: Liberia Concludes $5.7 Billion Mining and Infrastructure Deal With Bea Mountain
summary: The Liberian government completed a $5.7 billion agreement with Bea Mountain Mining Corp to build 270 megawatts of power generation capacity and a 146-kilometer highway financed by gold revenues.
why: Bea Mountain Mining Corporation is a major gold producer operating in West Africa.
